title: Calibrated Selective Prediction Using Deep Ensembles for ROI-Based Thyroid Nodule Ultrasound Classification Under Dataset Shift: A Retrospective Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2607.12075v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Background: Deep learning models can classify thyroid nodules on ultrasound, but reliable clinical decision support also requires calibrated probabilities, uncertainty estimation, and selective referral, particularly under dataset shift.   Methods: We developed a calibrated deterministic five-member deep ensemble for ROI-based thyroid nodule classification and selective image-based triage. TN5000 was used for model development, five-fold cross-validation, member-wise vector-scaling calibration, and fold-specific threshold selection. TN3K served as an independent external dataset-shift evaluation. translated_title: 基于深度集成的校准选择性预测用于数据集偏移下基于ROI的甲状腺结节超声分类：一项回顾性评估
translated_abstract: 背景：深度学习模型能够对超声图像上的甲状腺结节进行分类，但可靠的临床决策支持还需要校准的概率、不确定性估计以及选择性转诊，尤其是在数据集偏移的情况下。方法：我们开发了一种经过校准的确定性五成员深度集成模型，用于基于ROI的甲状腺结节分类和基于图像的选择性分诊。TN5000数据集用于模型开发、五折交叉验证、逐成员向量缩放校准以及各折特定的阈值选择。TN3K数据集作为独立的外部数据集偏移评估。该框架使用带有挤压与激励注意力机制的ConvNeXt-Tiny、集成平均恶性概率，并以互信息（MI）作为集成分歧评分。一个三层分诊策略将图像分配为“无需FNA建议”、“FNA推荐”或“放射科医生复查”。结果：在汇总的TN5000折外预测上，该集成模型（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究提出了一种基于五成员深度集成且经校准的甲状腺结节超声分类框架，以互信息作为不确定性评分实现三层选择性分诊（无需FNA、推荐FNA或放射科医生复查），并在外部数据集偏移条件下验证了其可靠性。
en_tdlr: This study proposes a calibrated five-member deep ensemble framework for ROI-based thyroid nodule ultrasound classification that uses mutual information as an uncertainty score to enable three-tier selective triage (No-FNA, FNA recommendation, or radiologist review), with reliability validated under external dataset shift.
